taskKinds.create.help: The task gets this kind, these fields, and a section listing the stages and labelled done criteria appended to its description. That description is the only way the template reaches the Bot.
taskKinds.create.unavailable: Templates could not be loaded. Try again. Details: {error}
taskKinds.editor.fieldsHelp: One field per line as key | label | flags | default; flags are required and relates (equal values relate tasks).
taskKinds.editor.invalidSla: The target time must be a positive number of hours.
taskKinds.editor.invalidStages: Write at least one stage, and give each stage at least one criterion line starting with -.
taskKinds.editor.kindHelp: Lower-case letters, digits and hyphens. It cannot change later, and a built-in's key cannot be reused.
taskKinds.editor.name: Name
taskKinds.editor.stagesHelp: One stage per line as key | name, with | checkpoint when a checkpoint is required, followed by its criteria on lines starting with -.
taskKinds.panel.heading: Kind: {name}
taskKinds.progress.deliveredOpenCriteria: Delivered while these criteria were last reported open: {labels}
taskKinds.progress.evidence: {count, plural, =0 {no evidence named} one {# evidence path} other {# evidence paths}}
taskKinds.progress.heading: Done criteria
taskKinds.progress.note: Read from the Bot's checkpoints and deliveries by criterion label. Nothing is corrected automatically.
taskKinds.related.heading: Related tasks
taskKinds.related.methodEmbedding: Text similarity from the embedding service.
taskKinds.related.methodFallback: The embedding service did not answer; text similarity is word overlap.
taskKinds.related.none: No related task of this kind.
taskKinds.related.note: Possible duplicates are only flagged; nothing is merged.
taskKinds.templates.heading: Templates
taskKinds.templates.intro: A template names a kind of work: its stages, done criteria, required checkpoints, review role, target time and fields. Built-in templates are read-only; copy one to change it. Their contents are starting choices and have not been evaluated.
